title: Indirect Tax - Consultant - Abu Dhabi, UAE
description: MENA Indirect Tax Consultant At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​ Join EY and help to build a better working world. The opportunity EY is looking for a Consultant to join the Indirect Tax team to advise clients on VAT treatment of new and complex transactions and help resolve classification or other disputes and issues with the authorities. Your key responsibilities Client responsibilities You are expected to work effectively as a member of a worldwide network of professional advisors, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress. You must also collaborate with a team of VAT professionals to combine diverse cross-border transaction experience with local tax knowledge across a broad spectrum of industries. Participating and assisting in preparing for meetings with management teams will be part of your role. You will be assisting in preparing reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other parties. You will also develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel and build strong internal relationships within the VAT practice, Indirect Tax and across other service lines. Technical responsibilities You must build a deep understanding of the Customs Law and its practical application across the countries. You are expected to understand and apply the regional Free Trade Agreements and key customs concepts such as valuation, classification and origin. You will be identifying and discussing VAT considerations for clients to be aware of in their outbound investments. Engaging with colleagues in overseas offices to deliver VAT advice in respect of global jurisdictions will be part of your responsibilities. You will also prepare for the potential introduction of VAT in the different countries and to discuss with clients how this may impact them as well as work with internal teams to provide indirect tax expertise for audit and transaction projects. Skills and attributes for success You must be able to build strong client relationships & excellently communicate in a range of situations in both written and oral English. You should also be able to identify areas of risk, carry out an effective review and know when to refer upwards. You are expected to be a client focused and commercially aware team player with the ability to build effective relationships at all levels. You must also possess project management skills, plan and prioritise work, meet deadlines, monitor own budget. You should also be able to solve problems creatively and pragmatically. Qualifications & Experience: A degree in economics, finance, tax or accounting At least One year of relevant experience as Indirect Tax professional Experience working for a Big 4 accounting firm is preferred. However, we will consider candidates with from law firms or with relevant industry experience Customs duty advisory experience is preferable, but we will also consider candidates with VAT/GST advisory experience What we look for Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident team player that collaborates with people from various teams while looking to develop your career in a dynamic organization. This role supports development teams across the software delivery lifecycle by improving CI/CD capabilities, infrastructure automation, cloud operations, monitoring, release management, and platform reliability. The DevOps Engineer ensures that solutions are secure, scalable, observable, and aligned with enterprise technology standards. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient, repeatable, and secure software delivery. Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational tasks using Infrastructure as Code practices. Support cloud platform operations, including environment setup, deployment automation, scaling, monitoring, and incident resolution. Collaborate with developers, architects, security teams, and project managers to ensure smooth delivery from development through production. Define and maintain deployment strategies, release processes, branching models, and environment management practices. Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions to improve system reliability and operational visibility. Support containerized and cloud-native workloads, including orchestration, runtime configuration, and deployment automation. Ensure DevOps practices comply with enterprise architecture, security, cloud, and operational standards. Identify performance, reliability, and deployment risks, and proactively implement mitigation actions. Troubleshoot build, deployment, infrastructure, and production issues in collaboration with development and operations teams. Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, environments, deployment procedures, operational runbooks, and platform standards. Promote DevOps culture, automation-first thinking, and continuous improvement across delivery teams. Experience with scripting and automation using languages such as Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar. Understanding of networking, security, identity, secrets management, and cloud governance principles. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, and deployment layers. Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, dependency checks, policy-as-code, and secure release gates. Experience supporting microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, or cloud-native architectures. Familiarity with ITIL, incident management, change management, and production support processes. Understanding of enterprise architecture standards and regulated delivery environments. description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Senior Manager - Banking Financial Risk The opportunity As our Senior Manager or Director –Financial Risk – Banking (Credit Risk and Climate Risk), you’ll work with clients in Financial Services to lead the management and measurement of financial risks including credit risk and climate risk. Engagements will vary and will commonly be centred around strategic risk initiatives, large-scale transformation, regulatory change, and the development, validation, and use of models. You will work closely with other financial services risk practitioners, technology consulting, and financial accounting teams to support clients’ highly specific and complex requirements. You will play a leading role across a portfolio of projects, combining deep technical expertise with strong commercial judgment to shape client solutions, oversee delivery quality, and build trusted senior stakeholder relationships. You will also help grow the practice through business development, thought leadership, and the coaching and development of high-performing teams. This is a hybrid role based in Warrang – Sydney or Naarm - Melbourne Your key responsibilities You’ll provide financial risk consulting services to clients mainly within the banking sector. Your responsibilities will include leading complex engagements, overseeing delivery quality and commercial outcomes, building senior client relationships, and delivering strategic advice that helps clients manage risk, optimise performance, and drive transformation. You’ll have opportunities to: Lead complex financial risk engagements across a diverse range of clients, delivering high-quality outcomes Shape and oversee the development of financial risk models, methodologies, and broader risk management solutions tailored to client needs Support our clients to uplift model risk management and AI model risk management Work with our global teams to bring leading practice insights into to our local clients Provide strategic advice on risk management, regulatory change, and transformation priorities, including engagement with senior client stakeholders Drive business development by identifying opportunities, contributing to proposals, and expanding existing client relationships Coach and develop team members, foster an inclusive high-performing culture, and support the growth of the broader practice Skills and attributes for success Qualifications and Experience: A Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field such as Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Engineering or a related field. A professional qualification (e.g., CFA or FIAA) is desirable, with typically 8+ years of relevant professional experience in consulting, banking or financial risk management. Experience with coding, programming, data analytics, and AI/GenAI is highly valued. Skills and Abilities: Proven analytical and problem-solving skills; strong quantitative abilities; proficiency with programming languages such as R and/or Python. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex information into practical insights for senior non-specialists and executive audiences. Industry Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the banking sector. Experience in areas such as credit risk , capital and stress testing, climate risk (climate scenario analysis and disclosure requirements) risk management frameworks (including credit risk, model risk and AI risk), controls, prudential standards, and regulatory change is advantageous. Brings initiative, sound judgment, and a practical approach to solving client problems. title: Business Transformation Manager - EY GDS
description: At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. This role is designed for a Business Transformation Manager who thrives at the intersection of process transformation, technology, and delivery ownership, including data and AI enabled change. As a Business Transformation and Enablement Manager, you will proactively identify opportunities for improvement, shape fit-for-purpose solutions and take end-to-end ownership of transformation initiatives. You will work in high-impact environments that emphasize accountability, collaboration, and the delivery of measurable outcomes. The opportunity As a Transformation Manager, you will play a crucial role in driving large-scale transformation across EY Global Delivery Services. You will diagnose current-state business processes, identify improvement opportunities, and design data-driven solutions. Working closely with cross functional teams, you will develop and deploy transformation initiatives, while partnering with the business to enable adoption and scale impact. title: Accounting & Tax Compliance Junior
description: To nejdůležitější v pár větách Láká tě propojení daní, účetnictví a auditu při práci pro mezinárodní společnosti? Klientům nabízíme rychle rostoucí outsourcingovou službu z oblasti daní a financí, která jim umožňuje zaměřit se na strategické a obchodní priority. Připravujeme lokální účetní závěrky a daňová přiznání na základě podkladů a dat od klientů. Naším úkolem je zajistit účetní a daňovou Compliance na základě českých účetních standardů a daňových předpisů. Také vedeme účetnictví a pomáháme s reportingem do mateřských firem. Tvoje role v týmu „Tvojí náplní práce bude vedení účetnictví včetně DPH reportingu, příprava účetních závěrek a daňových přiznání. Pracujeme ve vícečlenných týmech, a tak pomoc je vždy nablízku. Díky časté zpětné vazbě budeš vědět, na čem jsi a brzy se naučíš, jak funguje účetnictví jako celek. Záběr naší práce je podobný jako v auditu a s auditory úzce spolupracujeme. Jsme součástí nejnovějších trendů ve financích. Díky technologiím cestujeme minimálně a jen tam, kde to dává smysl. Práce na dálku pro nás není problém, ale pravidelně se potkáváme v brněnské kanceláři. Všechno děláme tak, aby nás práce bavila a nebyla to rutina. Svůj čas vážíme a vyvažujeme. Když je potřeba, mákneme, ale když je volněji, netrávíme v kanceláři zbytečné přesčasy.“ Kateřina Dedková, Partner, ACR Co je pro nás důležité Víme, že jsi teprve na začátku kariéry. Tady je několik věcí, které jsou pro tuhle práci podstatné. Máš dokončeného inženýra nebo magistra, nebo budeš mít hotovo v letošním či příštím roce. Předměty účetnictví a daně tě bavily. Máš základní znalost účetnictví a práce s čísly. Chceš se zdokonalit v práci s excelem a nebojíš se práce s různými online nástroji. Na problémy našich klientů často řešení v učebnicích nenajdeš. Musíme je spolu vymyslet. Angličtinu používáme opravdu často – ze začátku zejména v běžné korespondenci, později při práci se zahraničními kolegy a s klienty. Každý den se naučíš něco nového. Během dne tě většinou čeká práce na více projektech, a tak se ti hodí chladná hlava a chuť učit se a dobrý time-management. Jako tým se potkáváme v kanceláři v Brně 2 -3x týdně. Na nástupu se s tebou rádi dohodneme individuálně. Pokud můžeš pracovat pravidelně, domluvíme se i na částečném úvazku (min. 3,5 dne). Jak se ti odměníme Nástup 45 000 korun měsíčně a dále například: 6 týdnů volna, abys mohl/a načerpat nové síly. Benefitní body: 30 000 v Cafeterii můžeš utratit podle sebe. Třeba si pořídit Multisport kartu, nakoupit dárky nebo si užít odpočinek na Slevomatu. iPhone i k soukromému používání. Odměna za doporučení kandidáta: Získej od 10 do 70 tisíc Kč za doporučení nového kolegy. Přístup do externího vzdělávacího systému. Studium a členství na Institutu certifikace Svazu účetních nebo později ACCA. Podpoříme tvůj kariérní růst pravidelným counsellingem a vnitrofiremním vzděláváním. Podporujeme home office. Co tě čeká po odeslání přihlášky Prvním krokem jsou vstupní testy, které vyplníš online z domova. Budou celkem tři: z angličtiny, z numeriky a logického myšlení a na jejich vyplnění budeš mít týden. Poté tě čeká jednokolové výběrové řízení – hodinový pohovor u nás v brněnské kanceláři se zástupci managementu týmu ACR. A do týdne od nás dostaneš zpětnou vazbu.

title: Studio+ Sales Transformation - Senior Consultant - Location Open
description: Location: Anywhere in Country At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. Studio+ Sales Transformation - Senior We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Senior Consultant to join our Sales transformation practice within EY Studio+. In this role, you will work with client business teams spanning across the lead-to-cash process to help clients reimagine capabilities across their sales strategy, sales operations, sales process, and sales technology to accelerate revenue growth or optimize their sales efficiency. As a member of our Sales Transformation team, you will use your skills across the lead-to-cash/Lead-to-order process areas as well as your industry expertise to deliver complex, client engagements to drive our clients’ success. Whether you’re helping a client define their customer segmentation, sales coverage model, or defining the sales process that will inform a technology implementation, you will work on a dynamic mix of projects helping our clients solve some of their most pressing issues designing and implementing the future of sales. On this team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to imagine the future as well as create it, where you can craft ideas and implement them for our clients. Your key responsibilities As a Senior Consultant, you will participate in the design and implementation phases of client projects. Daily, you will support or lead analyses and work product development on a client-facing team. You will conduct qualitative and quantitative research, synthesize findings, and formulate recommendations to support client goals and objectives. Key responsibilities include: Conduct internal and external research on leading practices for B2C and B2B sales organizations Lead client stakeholder interviews to understand the business landscape and identify opportunities for improvement Document sales processes and the enabling technology that supports each process Prepare materials and facilitate client workshops Collaborate with client executives to assess sales strategies, capabilities, processes, and technologies to identify opportunities for improvement Support the assessment and implementation of enterprise sales technology platforms and tools (e.g., CRM, CPQ tools, CLM tools) Mentor junior team members, fostering a culture of growth, collaboration, and innovation. Stay ahead of emerging trends in sales operating models, customer experience, sales technologies, and AI. Consulting Services – Sales Transformation Senior To qualify for the role, you must have Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree) bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Data Analytics, or a related field; MBA or equivalent can also be considered 3+ years of work experience in consulting or industry position with a focus on commercial functions or related technologies (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Pricing) Experience effectively prioritizing workload to meet deadlines and work objectives. Problem solving and troubleshooting skills with experience exercising mature judgment in both internal and client-facing situations. Demonstrated experience delivering work in core consulting competencies such as workshop planning and coordination, leading practice research, current state assessment, gap analysis, future state roadmap definition Possess advanced analytical and collaborative problem-solving skills and demonstrate the ability to conceptualize components of a business issue to aid in the analysis and definition of solutions. Excellent presentation skills, and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and effectively to all audiences Strong interpersonal and leadership skills and a desire to build teams Ability to use Microsoft Suite programs A valid passport and US driver’s license; willingness and ability to travel estimated 50-80% both domestically and internationally. Skills and attributes for success Demonstrated experience working in teams that require collaboration across business or technology functions engaged in the lead-to-cash process (e.g., marketing, sales, pricing, order management, finance) Knowledge of B2C and B2B sales environments including common roles within a sales organization, core components of a sales process, tools utilized by a sales organization, and KPIs typically measured Knowledge of sales leading practices, processes and technologies to help drive customer-centric solutions for helping clients reinvent their future state sales strategy. Understanding sales solutions (CRM, CPQ, CLM) and working with clients to assess their current digital technology maturity, identify gaps and shape a comprehensive end-to-end sales technology roadmap. Understanding of delivering end-to-end technology programs from inception to go-live and ability to bring lessons learned to accelerate our ability to successfully deliver engagements. Knowledge of key trends and associated technical capabilities to liaise with both business and IT stakeholders around management of the overall sales strategy, processes and needed technologies. Ability to foster an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment. You’ll play an active role in counselling and mentoring staff consultants within the organization by providing structured, on-the-job feedback and creating meaningful experiences to develop your core consulting skills. Ideally, you’ll also have Basic technical knowledge of key Sales CRM technology solutions (e.g.,. Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics); CPQ technology solutions (e.g., PROS, SFDC CPQ, Oracle CPQ); and CLM technology solutions (e.g., Conga, SirionLabs, Docusign, etc.) and experience implementing such solutions for clients across different industries. Certification in any of the above technologies is a plus. Familiarity with AI use cases that support sales functions Working knowledge of agile delivery methodology or experience working in a team that operates in an agile fashion Awareness of industry trends, best practices and technological innovations to refine/evolve sales strategies accordingly. What we look for We are seeking top performers who demonstrate a blend of talents and skills, including the ability to think strategically, execute tactically, and engage collaboratively with a wide range of business stakeholders. You should be passionate about driving change and innovation, possess strong leadership qualities, and have the capacity to deliver complex projects with a focus on results and client satisfaction. Individuals who bring a collaborative, team-oriented working style and are used to delivering projects that engage multiple business or technology functions excel on our sales transformation projects. What we offer youAt EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $97,300 to $178,300. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $116,700 to $202,600. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Your responsibilities will include executing SAP FI and/or CO design, configuration and testing tasks, contributing to solution design decisions, and supporting documentation and validation activities. You have hands‑on experience in SAP Finance (FI) and/or Controlling (CO) and can translate business requirements into practical system solutions. You are comfortable working with both business users and technical colleagues, communicate clearly in English, and bring a collaborative, proactive mindset to everything you do. You are curious about SAP S/4HANA and motivated to continuously deepen your skills as technologies and ways of working evolve. You’ll benefit from EY’s strong investments in AI and advanced technology, global collaboration opportunities, and continuous coaching and training to support long‑term career growth. Our inclusive culture is built on trust, teamwork and development – and your ideas and ambition matter. We invest in the wellbeing of our employees, and we have a relaxed and caring work community where over 90% of our employees feel they can be themselves. We also offer diverse training opportunities, over 50 employee benefits, a flexible hybrid working model, and coaching to support career development and wellbeing. title: Manager Employer Reward
description: About EY People Advisory Services (PAS): At EY, our People Advisory Services (PAS) within the Tax & Legal service line specialize in all aspects of people management. This budget will allow you to use your employer-provided compensation for alternative transportation means or similar benefits, incl. reimbursement of housing costs (on condition you live within 10km of your main place of employment). We will actively support you in building a successful career and delivering excellent client service without sacrificing your personal priorities. We offer flexible working hours and working from home multiple days per week is possible. Inspiring work environment - At EY we are dedicated to providing you with an inspiring work environment. A work environment that allows you to further develop your skills and enables you to fulfill your true potential. We offer a clear career path tailored to your unique skills with necessary guidance. You’ll learn how to leverage AI in a smart and efficient way in your day-to-day work, while developing skills to identify, quantify and track value creation when integrating AI into client environments. Sustainability - We have a fleet of hybrid and electric cars. Our flex plan makes it possible for you to choose the most sustainable option for you. You can also opt for a train subscription or lease a bike. Location - All of our offices are easily accessible by public transport and/or by car and have parking space. They all have parking spaces and charging stations are provided. Through our coaching and training programs, you’ll develop the skillsets you need to stay relevant today and in the future – all while building a network of colleagues, mentors, and leaders who will be on the journey with you at EY and beyond.

Strong skills in functional application design, including business process analysis and solution documentation. Experience gathering, analyzing, and translating business and technical requirements into SAP‑based solutions. A flexibility and willingness to travel to meet client needs; travel is estimated at 40-60%. Experience with SAP external integrations to MES, MII, ME, DMC, etc. SAP certifications in SAP Manufacturing, Quality Management (QM) or related modules in the production execution space. Une expérience dans des environnements Microsoft Azure (Azure SQL, Synapse, Data Factory) est fortement appréciée. Connaissance des pratiques Git / CI/CD appréciée. Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements internationaux et collaboratifs. Maitrise de l’anglais à l’oral et à l’écrit. Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo. De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris.. Ces entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions. Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. description: At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Our clients span Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Supply Chain, Finance, and other global industries. You will help organizations modernize their data ecosystems, build scalable analytics platforms, and unlock actionable insights. The Opportunity We are seeking an experienced AWS Data Engineering Manager with deep expertise in PySpark, SQL, ETL engineering, AWS data services, and modern data lakehouse architectures. This is a leadership role within a rapidly growing practice, offering the chance to guide high-impact, enterprise-grade data programs. Key Responsibilities Technical Leadership Architect, design, and oversee scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using PySpark, SQL, Python, and AWS data services. Lead the implementation of data lakehouse solutions using AWS S3, Glue, Iceberg, and other cloud-native components. Drive migration of on-premises data workloads to AWS, ensuring performance, reliability, scalability, and cost optimization. Define and standardize metadata-driven ingestion frameworks and medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture patterns. Provide direction on Spark job optimization, distributed processing, and performance tuning. Delivery & Governance Lead teams in building and operationalizing data pipelines using orchestration tools such as Astronomer (Airflow), AWS Step Functions, and managed workflows. Ensure adherence to data quality frameworks, best practices, and coding standards. Review architecture, design, and code artifacts; troubleshoot complex technical issues. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including BI, data science, and product teams for seamless data delivery. People & Stakeholder Management Mentor and guide data engineers and senior engineers in technical delivery. Work directly with business and technical stakeholders, translating requirements into scalable solutions. Facilitate Agile/Scrum delivery across multi-functional teams. Optional (Good to Have) Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, PySpark notebooks, Unity Catalog). Familiarity with modern governance frameworks and MLOps/DevOps integrations. Skills and Attributes for Success 9+ years of overall IT experience, with 5+ years in AWS-based data engineering and at least 2+ years in a leadership/managerial capacity. Advanced hands-on expertise in: PySpark, SQL, Python AWS S3, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, CloudWatch ETL/ELT design and data lake/lakehouse architectures Apache Iceberg or similar table formats Airflow/Astronomer or equivalent orchestration tools Strong understanding of structured/semi-structured data formats (Parquet, JSON, CSV, XML). In-depth knowledge of DW concepts, dimensional modeling, and performance optimization. Practical experience with CI/CD frameworks (GitHub, Azure DevOps, Jenkins). Proven analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. To Qualify, You Must Have Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field. 9+ years of industry experience with significant hands-on exposure to cloud data engineering. Experience designing and managing production-grade AWS data platforms. Demonstrated success leading Agile/Scrum delivery teams. Ability to own deliverables end-to-end with a proactive, self-driven approach. Ideally, You’ll Also Have Prior client-facing experience and ability to influence senior stakeholders. Experience delivering in multi-environment, large-scale enterprise data landscapes. Exposure to Databricks, Delta Lake, or governance frameworks such as Unity Catalog. What We Look For We seek technically strong, innovative, and adaptable leaders who enjoy mentoring teams, solving complex data challenges, and driving continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment. title: Consultant(e) Expérimenté(e) - Contrôle de Gestion & Comptabilité Analytique - Paris - H/F
description: Les équipes Financial Accounting and Advisory Services (FAAS) d’EY accompagnent les directions financières pour répondre aux grands enjeux de la fonction finance : mesurer l’efficacité et la création de valeur des entreprises, accompagner dans la transformation digitale, être acteur de la stratégie de l’entreprise, participer à la politique d’investissement et de financement mais aussi optimiser les processus et améliorer le contrôle de la fonction finance. EY propose un large éventail de services en matière de transformation de la fonction finance, de pilotage de la performance, de reporting consolidé, d’excellence comptable, de trésorerie, d’optimisation des processus financiers et de contrôle interne, et d’assistance comptable pour les transactions (acquisition, carve out, introduction en bourses, refinancement…). Ses interventions couvrent tous les secteurs de l’économie, de l’industrie aux activités de services. Les clients sont principalement des groupes français ou internationaux, cotés ou non. Devenez acteur du changement et contribuez à élaborer un Better Working World. Vos missions Nous recherchons un nouveau membre pour rejoindre notre équipe Contrôle de Gestion & Comptabilité Analytique composée d’une quinzaine de personnes. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous pourrez mettre en pratique vos compétences en matière de Reporting et Contrôle de gestion afin de réaliser un diagnostic, proposer des axes d’amélioration et mettre en place des plans d’actions. Vous dirigerez et guiderez nos collaborateurs dans la réalisation de missions s’orientant autour de 3 grands axes : Comptabilité analytique & reporting : définition des indicateurs de performance opérationnelle, participation à la refonte de tableaux de bord rattachés à la fonction contrôle de gestion, participation à des projets en rapport avec le contrôle de gestion… Budget/Forecast : optimisation du processus budgétaire et articulation des différents cycles de gestion… Valorisation : définition d’une méthodologie de suivi de coûts en lien avec les enjeux métiers (achats, production…) ainsi que le calcul de prix de revient industriels… Selon votre degré de séniorité, vous êtes impliqué(e) dans l'animation de la ligne de service, dans son développement commercial et présentations aux clients. Pourquoi pas vous ? Le développement de nos collaborateurs est la clé de notre réussite : EY vous permet de personnaliser votre projet en fonction de vos appétences et vos souhaits de développement personnel. Formations dédiées, accès aux technologies de pointe et ressources documentaires spécialisées, mobilité interne, interventions d’experts, vous serez accompagnés tout au long de votre expérience EY pour relever les défis d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Avez-vous entendu parler du Smartworking chez EY ? Le SmartWorking vous permet de choisir les modalités de travail les plus appropriées à la conduite de vos missions en conciliant vos envies/engagements et nos services auprès de nos clients. Vous ne vivrez plus jamais le travail comme avant. Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure (bac+5) ; Vous avez une expérience réussie d'au moins 3 ans acquise au sein d’un service FP&A ou Contrôle de gestion ou en cabinet de conseil/audit ; Vous avez une connaissance d'outils d'ERP, de consolidation/reporting ou de BI ; Vous parlez couramment anglais pour évoluer dans un contexte international ; Vous avez un excellent sens relationnel, une aisance à l’oral et vous faites preuve de synthèse et rigueur. À propos d’EY EY rassemble aujourd’hui plus de 300 000 associés et collaborateurs à travers le monde dans plus de 150 pays. Grâce à ce réseau, dont le niveau d’intégration et l’ampleur internationale sont gages d’une même excellence partout dans le monde, EY renforce sa position de leader mondial de l’Audit, du Conseil, des Transactions, de la Fiscalité et du Droit. Nous faisons grandir les talents afin, qu’ensemble, ils accompagnent les organisations vers une croissance pérenne. Et notre engagement envers nos équipes commence avec cette promesse : quel que soit votre parcours avec nous, l’expérience EY dure toute une vie. Vivez l’expérience EY, Rejoignez-nous ! Dans le cadre de sa politique Diversité, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap.

Proven experience designing and delivering data solution architectures, ideally within cloud and modern data platform environments. Strong background in data architecture frameworks, data modeling, data governance, and best practices for scalable data platforms. Comfortable in client-facing roles, with strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills. Experience in presales, including requirements discovery, solution definition, cost estimation, and supporting RFP/RFI responses. Demonstrated ability to build proposals, lead project delivery, and manage resources (budgeting, team planning, timelines). Prior experience in consulting, professional services, or financial services is highly valued. Fluency in English and Spanish, both written and spoken. Hands-on expertise with modern data technologies such as Azure Data Services, Databricks, and Snowflake. title: Avocat expérimenté en Fiscalité Patrimoniale - Lyon - F/H
description: Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur. Vous souhaitez intégrer un cabinet d’avocats international leader sur le marché dont les valeurs sont l’excellence, l’engagement et l’innovation ? Rejoignez nos équipes ! Notre Opportunité : Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons actuellement un Avocat expérimenté en Fiscalité patrimoniale F/H disposant d’une expérience préalable de 3 à 5 ans au sein de notre bureau de Lyon. Vos principales responsabilités : Ce poste vous permettra de mettre à profit vos compétences en Droit Fiscal et plus particulièrement en Fiscalité Patrimoniale, en intégrant une équipe d'Avocats sur des missions de conseil ou de contentieux tant dans un contexte national qu’international, pour des entrepreneurs et dirigeants d’entreprises, des investisseurs français ou étrangers, des cadres dirigeants en mobilité. Vous participerez à des missions de conseil en matière de fiscalité des revenus et du capital, de la fortune et de transmission de patrimoine. Vous participerez à des restructurations de patrimoine personnel ou professionnel. Vous interviendrez également en matière de contrôle et de contentieux fiscal patrimonial, ainsi que dans le domaine déclaratif. Vous travaillerez dans un contexte pluridisciplinaire et serez en relation fréquente notamment, avec les autres bureaux EY en France et les autres bureaux du réseau international d’EY pour les besoins d’une clientèle internationale. Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans leurs choix stratégiques eu égard à l'ensemble des questions de fiscalité pouvant affecter leurs opérations et exploitations. Bien que basé au sein de l’équipe de Lyon, vous serez intégré au sein d’une équipe répartie sur plusieurs bureaux ce qui suppose une bonne adaptabilité et une certaine autonomie. Vos compétences pour réussir : Afin de vous intégrer au sein de nos équipes et d’y évoluer avec succès, vous détenez les compétences clés suivantes : Titulaire du CAPA après avoir obtenu un Master 2 en Fiscalité ou DJCE, et idéalement une formation complémentaire du type grande école de commerce option juridique et fiscale ou L.L.M ; Expérience préalable de 3 à 5 ans au sein du département "Droit Fiscal – Fiscalité Patrimoniale" d'un cabinet d'Avocats, d’une entreprise ou au sein d’une étude notariale ; Vous disposez d’une technique fiscale affirmée, de solides bases en matière de droit civil (régimes matrimoniaux et successoraux), de droit des sociétés, droit fiscal général et d’une bonne maitrise des données financières dédiées à l’ingénierie patrimoniale ; Maîtrise parfaite de l’anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit - une expérience professionnelle à l'étranger serait un atout ; Vous justifiez d’une première expérience réussie de management d’équipe et êtes également capable de développer le portefeuille clients de notre bureau. Ce que nous recherchons : Afin de vous intégrer et d'adhérer à la culture et aux méthodes du Cabinet, vous faites preuve : D’une grande autonomie, capable de prendre des initiatives avec rigueur et discernement, animée par une motivation constante et une forte disponibilité pour accompagner nos enjeux ; D’un esprit collaboratif affirmé, appréciant le travail en équipe et en transversalité, dans une dynamique de partage des expertises ; D’un sens du service développé et d’une aisance relationnelle favorisant des interactions fluides et constructives avec l’ensemble des interlocuteurs ; De capacités de leadership reconnues, permettant de mobiliser autour d’objectifs communs, dans un environnement exigeant et stimulant. Ce que nous vous offrons : Intégrer EY Société d’Avocats, c’est l’opportunité de : Travailler pour les plus grands clients leaders dans leurs secteurs, au sein d’équipes internationales et multiculturelles mais également pour des ETI familiales à forte croissance ; Appartenir à un réseau international et de travailler sur des dossiers transverses mêlant les métiers fiscal et juridique, de l’audit, du conseil et de la stratégie, ce qui apporte une vision 360 des projets, un atout clé pour nos clients ; Découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U ; Développer vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif ; Etre accompagné par une équipe de techniciens (Centre d’Etudes Juridiques et Fiscales) dédiée et spécialisée sur les sujets de fiscalité et de droit des affaires avec une veille quotidienne ; Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY. Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui. Processus de recrutement : Le processus de recrutement se déroule autour de deux types d’entretiens menés à distance et/ou en présentiel : Un échange RH : un membre de l’équipe Recrutement prendra contact avec vous pour établir votre intérêt pour le cabinet et votre motivation ; Des entretiens opérationnels : vous échangerez avec des membres de l'équipe afin de déterminer vos connaissances en matière de Fiscalité patrimoniale, d'établir votre niveau d'anglais ainsi que vos motivations à nous rejoindre. Les entretiens ont pour but d’évaluer vos connaissances et compétences, de discuter de votre parcours et de répondre à vos questions. Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap. Parce qu’elles connaissent les entreprises, leurs enjeux opérationnels et stratégiques et leurs contraintes, parce qu’elles rassemblent d’excellents experts et techniciens, les équipes d’EY Société d’Avocats s’attachent à proposer à nos clients une approche à la fois rigoureuse et pragmatique de la règle de droit, et devenir pour eux un véritable partenaire de confiance au quotidien. EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients à façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

title: Senior InfoSec Consultant
description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. The EY Global Information Security team is looking for new members helping manage security risk using the latest technologies and inventing new ways to work. If you are seeking a position that allows you to demonstrate your information security skills, experience, and ability to solve complex problems, this position is an opportunity to be involved embedding information security in many new projects as a part of EY’s Global Innovations practice that is intended to enable innovation. The opportunity Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. EY ALL IN global strategies are powered by multi-cloud capabilities, bringing the latest technical capabilities to EY internal and external clients. In doing so, we are empowering teams by enabling them with a strong technology core. Our business has an ambitious growth strategy and EY Global Information Security team is looking to hire a resource, dedicated to leading edge technologies in support of that growth. The EY Global Information Security team helps clients harness power of emerging technologies. We work with AL, Blockchain, and the latest cloud based capabilities to bring value to our Customers both external an internal. Working closely with our client engagement teams and with our technologists across the world, the EY security consulting practice supports digitally-enabled services that take advantage of leading technologies in concert with EY’s broad industry-specific experience and professional services knowledge. This allows clients to fundamentally re-imagine their Digital Practices throughout their business process lifecycles. The EY Global Innovations InfoSec Consulting team helps EY and their clients to improve the efficiency of their business functions through security new tools and capabilities. In addition, you will represent Security Consulting to the dedicated advanced innovation teams to enable the latest technology and thinking into our global technology team. Key responsibilities This position is a leading role in designing, developing, and accessing all aspects of security for market leading regional and global systems based primarily on Cloud technologies. As a security consultant dedicated to the Innovation teams you will be an individual contributor capable of supporting multiple project teams operating in the latest technologies of Cloud-based, Agile developed systems, using automated deployment from CI/CD pipelines. In other words, it is not just an audit or oversight role, but one that requires detailed participation in the design, implementation, and certification of security controls across solutions. This requires knowledge of various IT system architecture and Cloud technology, as well as supporting technologies such as AI, Blockchain, Quantum Computing, Cloud Security, user account management, audit and logging, and other security concepts as outlined in ISO27001/2, OWASP and related regional security standards. Also, the successful candidate should have knowledge of 3rd party security assessments and applicability of SOC1 and SOC2 reports, and concepts of vendor risk management. Skills and attributes for success Significant working security experience and knowledge in the design, implementation and operation of security controls in one or more of the following areas: Hands-on experiences of developing and implementing AI security technologies, especially Gen AI and rapid growing LLMs. Experiences with designing and enforcing security protocols to safeguard blockchain technologies and applications. Agile & DevOps Methodologies – Experience as a contributing member of a balanced team within an Agile development or DevOps environment. Cloud Security –Technical understanding of virtualization, cloud infrastructure, and public cloud offerings and experience designing security configuration and controls within cloud based solutions in Microsoft Azure and Azure PAAS services (SQL, Service Bus, Service Fabric, Data Lake, PowerBI) Application Security - Experience with the design of security controls for multi-tier business solutions including the design of application-level access and entitlement management, data tenancy and isolation, encryption, and logging. Working familiarity with REST API and microservices architecture. Infrastructure Security – Experience with the integration of common infrastructure security technologies and solutions into business solution architectures including the integration of identity & access management, intrusion detection and prevention, security monitoring, and data encryption solutions. Working experience with Open Source web technologies and programming languages, preferable with experiences in InfoSec Code Review. Significant experience in implementing security in a Microsoft Azure environment and practical knowledge of implementing global systems using a primarily PaaS and SaaS architecture, especially AI, Blockchain, Quantum Computing, Metaverse subjects. Direct knowledge of IT system architecture concepts and Cloud technology, as well as supporting technology such as IAM, network security, firewalls, user account management, audit and logging, and other security concepts as outlined in ISO27001/2, OWASP and related regional security standards. Advanced degree in Computer Science or a related discipline; or equivalent work experience. CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or similar security certifications preferred. Strong communication skills and ability to work with stakeholders ranging from developer to architects to business leaders to EY’s clients. Qualifications (Ideally) Although not required, it is preferred that candidates possess additional working security experience and knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Operational Security – Experience with defining operational models and procedures for business solutions including the operation and maintenance of infrastructure and application security controls. Information Security Standards – Knowledge of common information security standards such as: ISO 27001/27002, CSA and CIS Controls, etc Cloud security certifications such as AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer Product Management – working with a broader business team on aspects of security that affect all phases from concept to design to implementation and then operational support. What we look for We are looking for individuals with a passion for information security and demonstrated ability to apply their knowledge to new and emerging technologies that are supporting the growth strategy of a global professional services firm. What we offer you The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $128,100 to $239,600. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $153,800 to $272,300 . Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options. Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year. Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. title: Global Social Brand and Marketing Leader
description: At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. As the Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) function, we collaborate with the business to deliver innovative, audience-centric brand, marketing and communications. Our team is an integrated global network of over 2,500 professionals with skills in content development, editorial, webcast creation, events-staging, strategy, and operations. The Opportunity: As the Social Media Marketing Leader within the global Brand, Marketing, and Communications (BMC) function, you will play a pivotal role in developing and executing our next phase of social media to develop a social and influencer first brand marketing strategy behind key brand and GTM campaigns. EY has built a strong social presence, but with the rise of the creator economy, influencers and social media channels often the primary way to engage our audiences, we are developing the next phase where we want all brand marketing campaigns to be developed with a social first mindset, . The ideal candidate is a strategic digital native who pairs a strong understanding of impactful paid creative and marketing strategies across social media platforms, content and trends that drive brand performance, campaign and sales demand, with robust skills in branding, marketing and creative content development. The Global Social Brand and Marketing Leader will works collaboratively with the Global Social Media Leader, which leads on all reputation building, PR , leadership communications and manages overall reputation and platform governance. Key Responsibilities: Social Content & Marketing Strategy Development: Create and implement a comprehensive social media creative and marketing strategies aligned with the organization’s goals and objectives. Help define digital channels strategy, with a clear and distinct role for each platform. Lead digital and social media brand marketing programs with impact on top, middle and bottom of the funnel. Demonstrate the ability to drive brand shifting and demand generation programs including engagement of thought leadership Works closely with the brand and creative teams to elevate brand and creative campaign to be developed, where appropriate with a social-first mindset Identify target audiences and tailor content to engage them effectively. title: Sales Enablement Manager - EY Clients & Industries NL
description: Confidence in your impact today. Freedom to build tomorrow.At EY, you can be sure that you’re making a difference – for your client, for society, for your colleagues and for your own development. At the same time, you’ll have the freedom to work in a way that fits your life. Whether you choose to specialize, broaden your expertise or grow into leadership, you’re in the driver’s seat. Together with ambitious colleagues in an open and trusted culture, you aim for the best every day. Big on opportunity, friendly in collaboration. EY provides the resources you need to shape your career and make an impact in your field. Your new job | About your main responsibilitiesAt EY, we are shaping the future of business development as we transition to an industry‑led, client‑centric organization. To accelerate this ambition, we are looking for a Sales Enablement Manager who will play a pivotal role in translating strategy into execution and enabling our commercial teams to win in the market. This is a strategic and execution-oriented role at the heart of our Clients & Industries organization. You work closely with Clients & Industries leadership, sector teams, Finance, and business — both locally and internationally, to ensure that go-to-market priorities are turned into clear actions, robust pipeline management, and measurable commercial impact. You enable growth by shaping how EY goes to market: strengthening decision-making, improving commercial discipline, and ensuring that teams have the insights, tools, and focus needed to succeed. The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, commercial judgment, data and technology fluency, and hands-on delivery in a complex, international matrix environment. As Sales Enablement Manager, you will: Turn strategy into execution by translating growth priorities into clear go-to-market plans, actions, dashboards, and decision frameworks for market-facing teams, while identifying and driving improvements in commercial processes and ways of working. Enable data-driven growth by strengthening pipeline governance, reporting, improving insight quality, and leading the rollout, adoption, and consistent use of core sales processes, tools, and systems. Act as a strategic sparring partner to senior Clients & Industries leadership on growth priorities, investment choices, and commercial direction, grounded in data and performance insights. Connect teams and capabilities by orchestrating cross-functional initiatives and facilitating knowledge sharing across Clients & Industries, Finance, business – local and international stakeholders, ensuring alignment and execution. Embed a client-centric perspective by applying market, sector, and client insights to drive differentiation, focus, and commercial impact. Your new team | About your colleagues and the officeAt EY, services to our clients are organized into four service lines: Consulting, Strategy & Transactions, Tax, and Assurance. EY has a strong global presence. EY Netherlands focuses specifically on the following six industries: Government & Infrastructure, Industrials & Energy, Consumer & Health, Private Equity, Financial Services and Technology, Media & Telecommunications. The Clients & Industries (C&I) team plays an important role within EY. In the Netherlands, more than 40 ambitious C&I professionals work closely with colleagues from the business to provide optimal service to our clients and to develop new commercial initiatives. The C&I professionals are involved in all go-to-market initiatives across the industries and act as a central link within multidisciplinary account teams. As part of the C&I team, they play a key role in (leading) large commercial projects. Your office AmsterdamOur Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe. Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution 8+ years of experience in sales enablement, business development, commercial strategy, or go-to-market roles, ideally within a professional services or complex (international) B2B environment. Proven ability to translate strategy into execution, enabling commercial teams through clear priorities, tools, and insights. Demonstrated experience in rolling out and driving adoption of sales systems and supporting technologies, ensuring consistent use, data quality, and behavioral change across teams. Technology-savvy and data-literate, with the ability to leverage systems, dashboards, and digital tools to improve pipeline management, performance visibility, and decision making. Proven leadership in complex, matrix-driven organizations, with the ability to influence without authority and act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders. Strong commercial judgment, with the confidence to set direction, prioritize, and challenge constructively in a dynamic, fast-changing environment. A collaborative and resilient leadership style, combining analytical strength, emotional intelligence, and clear, structured communication to drive impact across functions and geographies. Comfortable working at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution, with a pragmatic mindset and a bias for action. Your benefits | About your perks and work enjoyment A competitive salary that reflects your role and responsibilities, depending on experience and qualifications. Plus, a solid pension plan for the future. In addition to your salary, you’ll receive holiday allowance and an annual bonus (based on performance and development). A laptop and phone for both work and personal use, and a monthly internet allowance. 34 vacation days to recharge and unwind, plus the option to buy extra days. With the mobility budget, you decide how you travel. Choose a lease car, a discounted public transport subscription, or arrange transport easily via our app. At EY, we care about a healthy work-life balance. Hybrid working makes this easier. Whether you're working from the office, at a client, or from home, we’ll make sure you have a well-equipped home office. The opportunity to work up to 20 days per year from abroad. The option to swap 3 national holidays for non-national ones. You’ll have the space to grow both personally and professionally. Whether you want to deepen your expertise, develop your personality, or improve your leadership style, we offer a broad range of trainings and courses. Your well-being is our priority. We believe that when you feel good, you perform better. That’s why you’ll have access to the OpenUp wellbeing platform (including for your family). You can easily connect with psychologists and lifestyle experts within 36 hours and take part in wellbeing sessions. A strong focus on teaming and various internal networks where you can join all kinds of social activities. A positive work atmosphere and good collaboration with colleagues contribute to your overall happiness at work. All this within an environment where our core values of integrity, inclusiveness, and respect are central. We think it’s important that you can be yourself and fully develop into the best version of yourself. Curious about all our benefits? Click here. Ready to shape your future with us? | About your application process1. For this vacancy, we ask you to upload a motivation letter along with your CV. This gives you the opportunity to show us your drive, motivation, and personality. At EY, we support the use of AI tools like ChatGPT, as long as your own tone and unique personality remain visible. 2. Our first contact: after your application, our recruiter will call you for a short introduction. We’ll explore whether the role could be a good match. 3. First interview: during this mutual introduction, we aim to get to know you better, while giving you the opportunity to ask any questions you may have. 4. Second interview: if we see a match and you’re still enthusiastic, we’ll invite you for a second interview. Before the interview, we’ll ask you to complete an online assessment. Not a standard questionnaire, but a game-based assessment focusing on both your cognitive skills and behavioral preferences. We’ll discuss the results during the interview. We’ll dive deeper into the role and other relevant topics. Sometimes, a business case is part of the process. A final interview may also follow. 5. We’re a match. You’ll receive an offer and we’ll perform a pre-employment screening. Then your new adventure begins. Welcome to EY! Research shows that women are less likely to apply if they don’t meet all the criteria. Please feel free to apply even if you don’t meet everything.

title: Consultant Senior en Transformation Digitale et SI H/F (Lyon)
description: Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur. Dans le cadre de leur développement, les équipes Technology Consulting de notre bureau de Lyon recherchent des Consultant Senior en Transformation Digitale et SI H/F. Votre rôle : Vous interviendrez auprès des Directions Générales, des Directions métiers et des Directions SI et Innovation pour réaliser des projets de transformation numérique : vous définirez la stratégie SI et le cadrage des projets ; vous piloterez les programmes et projets à réaliser ; vous définirez les besoins et assisterez nos clients dans la mise en œuvre de leurs programmes digitaux dans une logique d'optimisation de la performance et de maîtrise des risques projets. Vous serez amené(e) à intervenir sur toutes les étapes de la chaine de valeur : Vision stratégique, Schéma directeur, Etude d’opportunité ou de cadrage Benchmark des meilleurs pratiques du marché et études prospectives Analyse de la valeur, évaluation économique Accompagnement des directions dans la sécurisation de leurs projets et des feuilles de route Conception et réalisation Conduite du changement Pilotage projet (Comité de pilotage, reporting, plannings, etc.) En fonction de votre expérience antérieure, vous pourrez également intervenir sur des activités spécifiques, telles que : Stratégie « Move to Cloud », benchmark des offres Approche Agile, conception centrée utilisateurs / Design Thinking Lean Startup / MVP, approche Produit Développement durable et numérique responsable Innovation interne et intrapreneuriat Accompagnement au choix de solutions numériques Accessibilité numérique et solutions du marché Solutions innovantes GRC (chatbot, livechats, co-browsing, chat Communautaire, etc.) Gouvernance du SI Organisation de la DSI En tant que consultant(e) expérimenté(e), vous serez également amené(e) à : Conduire des activités et fournir des livrables clients en autonomie ; Apporter de la valeur ajoutée à vos clients à travers vos connaissances métiers, process, et/ou sectorielles ; Participer activement à la vie interne de l’équipe ; Développer vos connaissances en suivant des formations adaptées. Votre profil : H/F, de formation supérieure (école de commerce ou d'ingénieur), vous possédez une expérience d’au minimum 2 ans dans la transformation digitale en cabinet de conseil ou au sein d’un grand groupe international. Habitué(e) à conduire des projets de transformation en liaison directe avec des comités de direction, vous disposez potentiellement de certifications Scrum Master, Product Owner, SAFe Agilist, ou encore PMP, Management 3.0, ITIL, TOGAF, Lean Six Sigma, etc. Vous maîtrisez, le cas échéant, des outils projet (exemples : Teams, Jira, Trello, Github, Miro, Slack, ServiceNow, Triskell, etc.) Dynamique et doté(e) de qualités relationnelles, vous avez le sens du service client et vous bénéficiez de très bonnes capacités d'analyse. Vous avez également fait la preuve de votre capacité d’adaptation à des environnements variés lors d’un parcours d’excellence. Vous souhaitez évoluer dans un cadre de vie agréable, un équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnel et vivre en province. Vous parlez couramment anglais. Ce que nous vous offrons : Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif. Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à nos programmes de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U. Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo. De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris.. Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui. Processus de recrutement : Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 entretiens (RH et métier). Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions. Lors des entretiens métiers, nous vous proposerons également un exercice d’étude de cas ou market sizing à réaliser in situ. Dans le cadre de sa politique Inclusion, EY étudie, à compétences égales, toutes candidatures dont celles de personnes en situation de handicap. EY s'engage à créer de la valeur pour ses clients, ses collaborateurs, la société et la planète, tout en renforçant la confiance dans les marchés financiers. Grâce à la data, à l'intelligence artificielle et aux technologies avancées, les équipes aident les clients façonner l'avenir avec confiance et à développer des solutions pour les enjeux d’aujourd'hui et de demain. Les équipes EY interviennent dans l’audit, le conseil, la fiscalité, la stratégie et les transactions. Fortes d'une expertise sectorielle, d'un réseau multidisciplinaire connecté à l'échelle mondiale et de partenaires d'écosystème diversifiés, les équipes EY interviennent dans plus de 150 pays et territoires.

title: Avocat ou consultant expérimenté en Prix de Transfert - Lyon - F/H
description: Chez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur. Vous souhaitez intégrer un cabinet d’avocats international leader sur le marché dont les valeurs sont l’excellence, l’engagement et l’innovation ? Rejoignez nos équipes ! Notre opportunité : Notre équipe Prix de Transfert, dirigée par Nadia Sabin, est aujourd'hui la plus grande équipe en France. Elle compte plus de 60 collaborateurs, 12 associés, répartis entre nos bureaux de Paris, Strasbourg, Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes et Lille. Plus de 15 nationalités sont représentées au sein de notre équipe, qui évolue dans un environnement multiculturel où le français, l’anglais et d’autres langues telles que le japonais, l’espagnol, le portugais ou l’allemand sont couramment utilisées.Nos spécialistes prix de transfert sont des avocats, des économistes et des experts comptables de formation, avec des compétences différentes et complémentaires (e.g., marchés financiers, contentieux, valorisation) offrant une véritable pluridisciplinarité. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons actuellement un Avocat ou Consultant expérimenté en Prix de Transfert justifiant d’au moins 2 ans d’expérience pour notre bureau de Lyon. Vos principales responsabilités : La richesse des enjeux techniques et la diversité des secteurs d’activité de nos clients vous amèneront à intervenir sur une grande variété de missions, telles que : Conseil et structuration des flux intra-groupe Accompagner les clients dans la structuration juridique et fiscale de leurs flux transfrontaliers (redevances, management fees, services intra-groupe, transferts d’actifs, etc.). Analyser les risques fiscaux liés aux prix de transfert et proposer des solutions sécurisées ou des schémas alternatifs. Contrôles fiscaux et contentieux Assister les clients dans le cadre des opérations de contrôle, notamment par la participation à des réunions avec l’administration fiscale et la préparation de réponses écrites, etc. Participer à la rédaction d’actes de procédure. Accompagner et défendre nos clients dans le cadre de contentieux fiscaux. Prévention et résolution des différends Représenter nos clients dans le cadre de négociations avec les administrations fiscales françaises et étrangères. Participer à des réunions avec les autorités compétentes françaises au ministère de l’Économie et des Finances à Bercy. Préparer des dossiers de demandes d’APP et de MAP. Documentation des prix de transfert Réaliser des analyses fonctionnelles et économiques et rédiger des documentations prix de transfert. Gérer la stratégie documentaire globale des prix de transfert de nos clients. 5. Veille, formation et innovation Assurer une veille sur l’évolution des normes et pratiques en matière de prix de transfert (OCDE, UE, jurisprudence, doctrine administrative, etc.). Participer à des séminaires internes ou des évènements clients, rédiger des articles et contribuer à la conception et à la promotion d’outils digitaux innovants. Your new job | About your main responsibilities If you have a tech background and want to focus more on Finance while leading large projects and teams—and combine a content-driven role with go-to-market activities, this role is a perfect fit. EY’s Finance Consulting practice is looking for an experienced (Senior) Manager: Finance Technologies, Data & Platforms. As multinational organizations navigate massive shifts toward autonomous finance, the limitations of legacy data estates and fragmented systems have become the primary bottleneck for CFOs. True finance transformation, sophisticated FP&A, and AI readiness are only achievable if built upon a rock-solid, unified data foundation. In this senior leadership role, you will sit at the crucial intersection of enterprise corporate finance, modern financial systems, and data engineering. You will guide CFOs and enterprise architecture teams through complex initiatives to modernize their finance data models, integrate advanced EPM platforms, and design cloud-enabled, scalable reporting ecosystems that serve as the single source of truth for the enterprise. This area is a clear strategic growth priority. We are actively investing in expanding this capability, and you will play a key role in shaping and growing the team—building, leading, and making a lasting impact. Key responsibilities: Architectural Leadership: Act as the lead solution architect on high-stakes finance transformation programs, defining how financial systems, data models, and corporate reporting layers connect. Strategic CFO Advisory: Advise CFOs, Finance Directors, and CIOs on technology selection, platform rationalization, and the long-term ROI of modernizing their financial data infrastructure. Engagement Delivery: Oversee the end-to-end delivery of complex, platform-driven transformation projects, managing multi-disciplinary teams (developers, finance specialists, and data engineers) alongside delivery budgets and timelines. Business Development & Market Expansion: Spearhead commercial growth within the Dutch and European markets by identifying organizational data bottlenecks, crafting compelling platform-led proposals, and building long-term alliances with technology partners. Bridge Finance & Tech: Translate complex accounting rules, regulatory reporting demands, and business-driven FP&A requirements into rigorous, highly structured technical specifications and data architectures. Teaming & Talent Cultivation: Direct, coach, and inspire managers and consultants within the team, fostering deep technical expertise in EPM/ERP platforms alongside strategic consulting capabilities. Your new team | About your colleagues and the office Our Finance Data & Platforms solution bridges the gap between traditional finance functions and advanced technology architecture. We partner with blue-chip and global enterprises to design the blueprints for modern finance environments—ensuring data flows seamlessly from core ERPs to sophisticated planning and analytics engines. We work closely with corporate finance and technology leaders to solve enterprise-scale structural challenges: Finance Data Architecture & Modeling: Designing and rationalizing unified corporate data models, master data governance frameworks, and global charts of accounts (CoA) across complex multi-entity structures. Next-Gen EPM & FP&A Platforms: Directing the architectural design and strategic implementation roadmap for market-leading Enterprise Performance Management solutions (e.g., OneStream, SAP BPC/SAC, Anaplan, Tagetik) to transform corporate planning, budgeting, and financial closing. Data Fabric & Modernization: Overhauling legacy data silos by establishing cloud-enabled finance data lakes and warehouses, paving the way for trustworthy, real-time reporting and scalable AI deployment. ERP & Ecosystem Integration: Aligning enterprise finance platforms with complex core ERP landscapes (such as SAP S/4HANA or Oracle Cloud) to automate data pipelines, reduce manual manipulation, and optimize performance. As AI fundamentally continues to reshape the finance function, this competency represents the primary strategic growth area within EY Finance Consulting. As a Senior Manager, you will drive this expansion, collaborating across a multidisciplinary network including Finance Transformation, Global Business Services, Tech Strategy, Enterprise Risk, and Transactions. Our Finance Consulting team is a dynamic and diverse team, with team members coming from different countries. We work closely together and have an open culture. Join us and work on projects that drive meaningful change. Your office Amsterdam Our Amsterdam office is located at the Zuidas: a bustling area full of companies. In our Cross Towers, we welcome up to 1,500 people every day. For a breathtaking view of the city, head to the 22nd floor. Collaboration takes on a new meaning in our Wavespace, a high-tech environment that connects clients and colleagues virtually across the globe. Your skills and strengths | About your unique contribution Experience: At least 8+ years of experience in Finance Transformation, Finance Data Engineering, or EPM/ERP platform implementation, ideally within a tier-one consulting firm or as an internal enterprise architect for a global organization. Platform & Tech Savviness: Deep functional and technical knowledge of at least one major EPM ecosystem (e.g., OneStream, Anaplan, SAP Analytics Cloud/Group Reporting, Tagetik) or extensive data architecture experience tied to large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformations.
